verdict.rationale: jo exposes a real OpenAPI 3.1 spec with ~405 endpoints (jo-probe-2, jo-probe-rt-2), suggesting broad backend functionality is technically API-driven, but the evidence explicitly notes 'no developer program or public API keys are documented around it,' meaning end users/AI-native users cannot actually authenticate and call this API themselves to replicate UI actions. Missing for 10: a documented public API/developer program with auth for external users, parity documentation mapping UI features to API endpoints, and any independent confirmation that users can drive jo's full feature set (Linear, Slack, decks, websites) via API rather than chat/UI.
